text: I sought out Dejah Thoris in the throng of departing chariots.
zh: 我在离开的战车群中找到了德雅·索里斯。
chunks: I sought
out Dejah Thoris in the throng of departing chariots.

text: I believe that a few words relative to this remarkable personality will be of interest.
zh: 我相信，与这位非凡人物相关的几句话将会引起人们的兴趣。
chunks: I believe
that a few words relative to this remarkable personality will be of interest.

text: He was a splendid specimen of manhood, standing a good two inches over six feet, broad of shoulder and narrow of hip, with the carriage of the trained fighting man.
zh: 他是男子气概的典范，身高六英尺多两英寸，肩膀宽，臀部窄，有着训练有素的战士的举止。
chunks: He was a splendid specimen of manhood,
standing a good two inches
over six feet, broad of shoulder
and narrow of hip, with the carriage
of the trained fighting man.

text: I have often heard my father caution him against his wild recklessness, but he would only laugh, and say that the tumble that killed him would be from the back of a horse yet unfoaled.
zh: 我经常听到父亲告诫他不要鲁莽行事，但他只是笑笑，说他摔死的那一摔是从一匹尚未生驹的马背上摔下来的。
chunks: I have often heard my father caution him against his wild recklessness,
but he would only laugh,
and say that the tumble
that killed him would be from the back
of a horse yet unfoaled.

text: I owning and operating a string of general stores throughout Virginia at that time.
zh: 当时我在弗吉尼亚州拥有并经营一系列杂货店。
chunks: I owning
and operating a string of general stores throughout Virginia at that time.

text: I thought at the time that he was praying, although I never understood that he was in the strict sense of the term a religious man.
zh: 我当时以为他正在祈祷，尽管我从来不明白他是严格意义上的宗教人士。
chunks: I thought at the time
that he was praying,
although I never understood that he was
in the strict sense
of the term a religious man.

text: For some reason this news did not surprise me, but I hurried out to his place as quickly as possible, so that I could take charge of the body and of his affairs.
zh: 不知为何，这个消息我并没有感到惊讶，但我还是以最快的速度赶到了他的住处，这样我就可以负责他的尸体和他的事务了。
chunks: For some reason this news did not surprise me,
but I hurried out to his place
as quickly as possible,
so that I could take charge
of the body and of his affairs.

text: Left alone in the study, I opened the safe and withdrew the contents of the drawer in which he had told me I would find my instructions.
zh: 我独自留在书房里，打开保险箱，取出抽屉里的东西，他告诉我可以在里面找到我的指示。
chunks: Left alone in the study,
I opened the safe
and withdrew the contents
of the drawer
in which he had told me I would find my instructions.

text: His property was left in such a way that I was to receive the entire income for twenty-five years, when the principal was to become mine.
zh: 他的财产以这样的方式留下：我将在二十五年内获得全部收入，届时本金将成为我的。
chunks: His property was left
in such a way that I was
to receive the entire income
for twenty-five years, when the principal was
to become mine.

text: Possibly I am a hundred, possibly more; but I cannot tell because I have never aged as other men, nor do I remember any childhood.
zh: 也许我已经一百岁了，也许更多；但我无法判断，因为我从未像其他人那样变老，也不记得任何童年。
chunks: Possibly I am a hundred,
possibly more; but I cannot tell
because I have never aged
as other men,
nor do I remember any childhood.

text: I have never told this story, nor shall mortal man see this manuscript until after I have passed over for eternity.
zh: 我从未讲述过这个故事，在我永远去世之前，凡人也不会看到这份手稿。
chunks: I have never told this story,
nor shall mortal man see this manuscript
until after I have passed
over for eternity.

text: Masterless, penniless, and with my only means of livelihood, fighting, gone, I determined to work my way to the southwest and attempt to retrieve my fallen fortunes in a search for gold.
zh: 失去了主人，身无分文，唯一的谋生手段也失去了战斗力，我决心一路打拼到西南去，试图挽回失去的家产，去淘金。
chunks: Masterless, penniless, and with my only means
of livelihood, fighting, gone, I determined
to work my way to the southwest and attempt
to retrieve my fallen fortunes
in a search for gold.

text: As our equipment was crude in the extreme we decided that one of us must return to civilization, purchase the necessary machinery and return with a sufficient force of men properly to work the mine.
zh: 由于我们的设备极其简陋，我们决定我们中的一个人必须返回文明社会，购买必要的机器，并带着足够的人员返回矿山进行适当的工作。
chunks: As our equipment was crude in the extreme we decided
that one of us must return
to civilization, purchase the necessary machinery
and return with a sufficient force
of men properly to work the mine.

text: Some half hour later I happened to glance casually across the valley and was much surprised to note three little dots in about the same place I had last seen my friend and his two pack animals.
zh: 大约半小时后，我偶然瞥见山谷对面，非常惊讶地发现三个小点就在我上次见到我的朋友和他的两只驮畜的同一位置。
chunks: Some half hour later I happened
to glance casually across the valley
and was much surprised to note three little dots
in about the same place I had last seen my friend
and his two pack animals.

text: As soon as I reached comparatively level ground I urged my mount into a canter and continued this, where the going permitted, until, close upon dusk, I discovered the point where other tracks joined those of Powell.
zh: 当我到达相对平坦的地面时，我催促我的坐骑慢跑，并在行进允许的情况下继续这样，直到黄昏时分，我发现其他足迹与鲍威尔的足迹汇合的地方。
chunks: As soon
as I reached comparatively level ground I urged my mount
into a canter and continued this, where the going permitted, until,
close upon dusk, I discovered the point
where other tracks joined those of Powell.

text: About nine o’clock the moon was sufficiently bright for me to proceed on my way and I had no difficulty in following the trail at a fast walk, and in some places at a brisk trot until, about midnight, I reached the water hole where Powell had expected to camp.
chunks: About nine o’clock the moon was sufficiently bright
for me to proceed on my way and I had no difficulty
in following the trail at a fast walk,
and in some places at a brisk trot until, about midnight,
I reached the water hole where Powell had expected to camp.

text: I knew that Powell would need me now if ever, and I instantly urged my horse to his topmost speed up the narrow and difficult mountain trail.
zh: 我知道鲍威尔现在就需要我，如果有的话，我立即催促我的马以最快的速度沿着狭窄而困难的山路行驶。
chunks: I knew that Powell would need me now
if ever,
and I instantly urged my horse
to his topmost speed up the narrow
and difficult mountain trail.

text: Their attention was so wholly riveted to this point of interest that they did not notice me, and I easily could have turned back into the dark recesses of the gorge and made my escape with perfect safety.
zh: 他们的注意力完全集中在这个兴趣点上，没有注意到我，而我很容易就可以回到峡谷的黑暗深处，安全地逃走。
chunks: Their attention was so wholly riveted to this point of interest
that they did not notice me,
and I easily could have turned back
into the dark recesses of the gorge
and made my escape with perfect safety.

text: However that may be, I have never regretted that cowardice is not optional with me.
zh: 不管怎样，我从来没有后悔过，胆怯对我来说是不可选择的。
chunks: However that may be,
I have never regretted
that cowardice is not optional
with me.

text: Riding close to him I reached down from the saddle, and grasping his cartridge belt drew him up across the withers of my mount.
chunks: Riding close
to him I reached down
from the saddle,
and grasping his cartridge belt drew him up across the withers
of my mount.

text: It is probable, however, that to this fact I owe my life and the remarkable experiences and adventures which befell me during the following ten years.
zh: 然而，很可能，我的生命以及在接下来的十年里发生在我身上的非凡经历和冒险都归功于这一事实。
chunks: It is probable, however,
that to this fact I owe my life
and the remarkable experiences
and adventures which befell me
during the following ten years.

text: I knew the Indians would soon discover that they were on the wrong trail and that the search for me would be renewed in the right direction as soon as they located my tracks.
zh: 我知道印第安人很快就会发现他们走错了路，一旦他们找到了我的踪迹，他们就会重新朝正确的方向寻找我。
chunks: I knew the Indians would soon discover
that they were on the wrong trail
and that the search for me would be renewed
in the right direction as soon
as they located my tracks.

text: The opening was about four feet in height and three to four feet wide, and at this opening the trail ended.
zh: 这个开口大约有四英尺高，三到四英尺宽，小路就在这个开口处结束。
chunks: The opening was
about four feet
in height and three
to four feet wide,
and at this opening the trail ended.

text: I was very fond of Powell; he was thoroughly a man in every respect; a polished southern gentleman; a staunch and true friend; and it was with a feeling of the deepest grief that I finally gave up my crude endeavors at resuscitation.
zh: 我非常喜欢鲍威尔；他在各方面都是一个彻头彻尾的男人。一位优雅的南方绅士；一个坚定而真正的朋友；怀着最深切的悲痛，我最终放弃了粗暴的复苏努力。
chunks: I was very fond of Powell; he was thoroughly a man
in every respect; a polished southern gentleman;
a staunch and true friend;
and it was with a feeling of the deepest grief
that I finally gave up my crude endeavors at resuscitation.

text: As I was continuing my examination I commenced to feel a pleasant drowsiness creeping over me which I attributed to the fatigue of my long and strenuous ride, and the reaction from the excitement of the fight and the pursuit.
zh: 当我继续检查时，我开始感到一种令人愉快的睡意在我身上蔓延，我将其归因于我长时间而艰苦的骑行的疲劳，以及战斗和追击的兴奋所产生的反应。
chunks: As I was continuing my examination I commenced
to feel a pleasant drowsiness creeping over me which I attributed
to the fatigue of my long
and strenuous ride, and the reaction
from the excitement of the fight and the pursuit.

text: I attempted to spring to my feet but was horrified to discover that my muscles refused to respond to my will.
zh: 我试图站起来，但惊讶地发现我的肌肉拒绝响应我的意志。
chunks: I attempted to spring
to my feet
but was horrified to discover
that my muscles refused
to respond to my will.

text: There also came to my nostrils a faintly pungent odor, and I could only assume that I had been overcome by some poisonous gas, but why I should retain my mental faculties and yet be unable to move I could not fathom.
zh: 鼻孔里还飘来一股淡淡的刺鼻气味，只能推测是中了毒气，但为何神智尚存，却无法动弹，我却想不通。
chunks: There also came to my nostrils a faintly pungent odor,
and I could only assume
that I had been overcome by some poisonous gas,
but why I should retain my mental faculties
and yet be unable to move I could not fathom.

text: I had not long to wait before a stealthy sound apprised me of their nearness, and then a war-bonneted, paint-streaked face was thrust cautiously around the shoulder of the cliff, and savage eyes looked into mine.
zh: 没等多久，一阵隐秘的声音就让我知道他们已经靠近了，然后一张戴着战帽、涂满油漆的脸小心翼翼地推到了悬崖的肩部，用野蛮的眼睛看着我。
chunks: I had not long to wait
before a stealthy sound apprised me
of their nearness, and then a war-bonneted,
paint-streaked face was thrust cautiously around the shoulder of the cliff,
and savage eyes looked into mine.

text: That there were still other braves behind those who regarded me was apparent from the fact that the leaders passed back whispered word to those behind them.
zh: 从领导者们向身后的人低声传话的事实来看，在那些注视着我的人背后还有其他勇敢者。
chunks: That there were still other braves
behind those who regarded me was apparent
from the fact
that the leaders passed back whispered word
to those behind them.

text: The sound which had frightened them was not repeated, but it had been sufficient as it was to start me speculating on the possible horror which lurked in the shadows at my back.
zh: 令他们害怕的声音没有再出现，但这足以让我开始猜测潜伏在我背后的阴影中的恐怖。
chunks: The sound which had frightened them was not repeated,
but it had been sufficient
as it was to start me speculating
on the possible horror
which lurked in the shadows at my back.

text: The shock to my already overstrained nervous system was terrible in the extreme, and with a superhuman effort I strove to break my awful bonds.
zh: 对我已经过度紧张的神经系统的冲击是极其可怕的，我以超人的努力努力打破我可怕的束缚。
chunks: The shock
to my already overstrained nervous system was terrible
in the extreme,
and with a superhuman effort I strove
to break my awful bonds.

text: The transition had been so sudden and so unexpected that it left me for a moment forgetful of aught else than my strange metamorphosis.
zh: 这种转变来得如此突然、如此出人意料，以至于我一时间除了自己奇怪的变态之外什么都忘记了。
chunks: The transition had been
so sudden and so unexpected
that it left me
for a moment forgetful of aught else
than my strange metamorphosis.

text: My breath was coming in quick, short gasps, cold sweat stood out from every pore of my body, and the ancient experiment of pinching revealed the fact that I was anything other than a wraith.
zh: 我的呼吸急促而短促，冷汗从我身体的每一个毛孔中渗出，古老的捏捏实验揭示了我根本不是幽灵。
chunks: My breath was coming
in quick, short gasps, cold sweat stood
out from every pore of my body,
and the ancient experiment of pinching revealed the fact
that I was anything other than a wraith.

text: My carbine was in its boot, strapped to my saddle, and as my horse had wandered off I was left without means of defense.
zh: 我的卡宾枪在靴子里，绑在马鞍上，当我的马失控时，我失去了防御手段。
chunks: My carbine was in its boot,
strapped to my saddle,
and as my horse had wandered
off I was left
without means of defense.

text: As I did so I saw stretching far below me the beautiful vista of rocky gorge, and level, cacti-studded flat, wrought by the moonlight into a miracle of soft splendor and wondrous enchantment.
zh: 当我这样做的时候，我看到下面远处延伸着岩石峡谷的美丽景色，平坦的、长满仙人掌的平坦地带，在月光的照射下变成了一个柔和的辉煌和奇妙的魅力的奇迹。
chunks: As I did so I saw stretching far
below me the beautiful vista
of rocky gorge, and level, cacti-studded flat,
wrought by the moonlight
into a miracle of soft splendor and wondrous enchantment.

text: As I gazed at it on that far-gone night it seemed to call across the unthinkable void, to lure me to it, to draw me as the lodestone attracts a particle of iron.
zh: 当我在那个遥远的夜晚凝视它时，它似乎在召唤我穿越难以想象的虚空，引诱我走向它，像磁石吸引铁粒一样吸引我。
chunks: As I gazed at it
on that far-gone night it seemed
to call across the unthinkable void,
to lure me to it, to draw me
as the lodestone attracts a particle of iron.

text: I knew that I was on Mars; not once did I question either my sanity or my wakefulness.
zh: 我知道我在火星上；我从来没有质疑过自己的理智或清醒。
chunks: I knew
that I was
on Mars;
not once did I question either my sanity
or my wakefulness.

text: I seemed to be lying in a deep, circular basin, along the outer verge of which I could distinguish the irregularities of low hills.
zh: 我似乎躺在一个深深的圆形盆地里，沿着盆地的外缘，我可以分辨出不规则的低矮山丘。
chunks: I seemed to be lying
in a deep, circular basin,
along the outer verge
of which I could distinguish the irregularities
of low hills.

text: I alighted softly upon the ground, however, without appreciable shock or jar.
zh: 然而，我轻轻地落在地上，没有明显的震惊或震动。
chunks: I alighted softly
upon the ground, however,
without appreciable shock
or jar.

text: My muscles, perfectly attuned and accustomed to the force of gravity on Earth, played the mischief with me in attempting for the first time to cope with the lesser gravitation and lower air pressure on Mars.
zh: 我的肌肉完美地适应并习惯了地球上的重力，在我第一次尝试应对火星上较小的重力和较低的气压时，我起了恶作剧。
chunks: My muscles, perfectly attuned and accustomed to the force
of gravity on Earth, played the mischief
with me in attempting for the first time to cope
with the lesser gravitation
and lower air pressure on Mars.

text: The roof of the enclosure was of solid glass about four or five inches in thickness, and beneath this were several hundred large eggs, perfectly round and snowy white.
zh: 围墙的屋顶是厚约四五英寸的实心玻璃，下面有数百个大鸡蛋，它们浑圆、雪白。
chunks: The roof of the enclosure was
of solid glass about four
or five inches in thickness,
and beneath this were several hundred large eggs,
perfectly round and snowy white.

text: Their noses were but longitudinal slits in the center of their faces, midway between their mouths and ears.
zh: 他们的鼻子只是面部中央的纵向狭缝，位于嘴巴和耳朵之间。
chunks: Their noses were but longitudinal slits
in the center
of their faces,
midway between their mouths
and ears.

text: The iris of the eyes is blood red, as in Albinos, while the pupil is dark.
zh: 眼睛的虹膜是血红色的，就像白化病患者一样，而瞳孔是黑色的。
chunks: The iris
of the eyes is blood red,
as in Albinos,
while the pupil is dark.

text: Against the dark background of their olive skins their tusks stand out in a most striking manner, making these weapons present a singularly formidable appearance.
zh: 在橄榄色皮肤的黑色背景下，它们的獠牙以最引人注目的方式突出，使这些武器呈现出异常可怕的外观。
chunks: Against the dark background
of their olive skins their tusks stand
out in a most striking manner,
making these weapons present a singularly formidable appearance.

text: On such a little thing my life hung that I often marvel that I escaped so easily.
zh: 我的生命就悬在这样一件小事上，以至于我时常惊叹自己竟如此轻易地逃脱了。
chunks: On such a little thing my life hung
that I often marvel that I escaped so easily.

text: The man himself, for such I may call him, was fully fifteen feet in height and, on Earth, would have weighed some four hundred pounds.
zh: 这个人本人，我可以这么称呼他，足有十五英尺高，在地球上，体重约为四百磅。
chunks: The man himself,
for such I may call him,
was fully fifteen feet
in height and, on Earth,
would have weighed some four hundred pounds.

text: Its belly was white, and its legs shaded from the slate of its shoulders and hips to a vivid yellow at the feet.
zh: 它的腹部是白色的，腿从肩膀和臀部的石色逐渐变成鲜黄色的脚。
chunks: Its belly was white,
and its legs shaded from the slate
of its shoulders and hips
to a vivid yellow
at the feet.

text: Unarmed and naked as I was, the first law of nature manifested itself in the only possible solution of my immediate problem, and that was to get out of the vicinity of the point of the charging spear.
zh: 尽管我手无寸铁，赤身裸体，但自然的第一法则体现在解决我眼前的问题的唯一可能的办法中，那就是离开冲锋矛尖附近。
chunks: Unarmed and naked as I was,
the first law of nature manifested itself
in the only possible solution of my immediate problem,
and that was to get
out of the vicinity of the point of the charging spear.

text: I had not molested their young.
zh: 我没有骚扰他们的孩子。
chunks: I had not
molested their young.

text: The result is that they are infinitely less agile and less powerful, in proportion to their weight, than an Earth man, and I doubt that were one of them suddenly to be transported to Earth he could lift his own weight from the ground; in fact, I am convinced that he could not do so.
chunks: The result is that they are infinitely less agile
and less powerful, in proportion to their weight, than an Earth man,
and I doubt that were one of them suddenly to be transported
to Earth he could lift his own weight
from the ground; in fact, I am convinced that he could not do so.

text: These rifles were of a white metal stocked with wood, which I learned later was a very light and intensely hard growth much prized on Mars, and entirely unknown to us denizens of Earth.
zh: 这些步枪是用白色金属制成的，里面装有木头，后来我才知道这是一种非常轻且非常坚硬的生长物，在火星上非常珍贵，但我们地球人却完全不知道。
chunks: These rifles were of a white metal stocked with wood,
which I learned later was a very light
and intensely hard growth much prized
on Mars, and entirely unknown
to us denizens of Earth.

text: This is quite far enough to imbue me with great respect for the Martian firearm, and some telepathic force must have warned me against an attempt to escape in broad daylight from under the muzzles of twenty of these death-dealing machines.
zh: 这已经足够让我对火星火器产生极大的敬意，并且一定有某种心灵感应力量警告我​​不要在光天化日之下从二十台这样的死亡机器的枪口下逃跑。
chunks: This is quite far enough
to imbue me with great respect for the Martian firearm,
and some telepathic force must have warned me against an attempt
to escape in broad daylight
from under the muzzles of twenty of these death-dealing machines.

text: When his force had come to a halt he dismounted, threw down his spear and small arms, and came around the end of the incubator toward me, entirely unarmed and as naked as I, except for the ornaments strapped upon his head, limbs, and breast.
chunks: When his force had come
to a halt he dismounted, threw down his spear
and small arms, and came around the end of the incubator
toward me, entirely unarmed and as naked as I,
except for the ornaments strapped upon his head, limbs, and breast.

text: Of course I might have been a babbling brook for all the intelligence my speech carried to him, but he understood the action with which I immediately followed my words.
zh: 当然，就我的演讲给他带来的智慧而言，我可能只是一条潺潺小溪，但他理解我立即按照我的话采取的行动。
chunks: Of course I might have been a babbling brook
for all the intelligence my speech carried
to him,
but he understood the action
with which I immediately followed my words.

text: They started toward us on a wild run, but were checked by a signal from him.
zh: 他们疯狂地向我们跑来，但被他发出的信号阻止了。
chunks: They started toward us
on a wild run,
but were checked
by a signal
from him.

text: The entire cavalcade then turned and galloped away toward the range of hills in the distance.
zh: 整个队伍转身，向着远处的山峦疾驰而去。
chunks: The entire cavalcade then turned
and galloped away toward the range of hills in the distance.

text: Upon closer observation I saw as we passed them that the buildings were deserted, and while not greatly decayed had the appearance of not having been tenanted for years, possibly for ages.
zh: 当我们经过它们时，经过仔细观察，我发现这些建筑物已被废弃，虽然没有严重腐烂，但看起来已经多年（甚至可能很长时间）无人居住了。
chunks: Upon closer observation I saw as we passed them
that the buildings were deserted,
and while not greatly decayed had the appearance
of not having been tenanted
for years, possibly for ages.

text: Their bodies were smaller and lighter in color, and their fingers and toes bore the rudiments of nails, which were entirely lacking among the males.
zh: 他们的身体更小，颜色更浅，手指和脚趾上有指甲的雏形，这是雄性中完全没有的。
chunks: Their bodies were smaller
and lighter in color, and their fingers
and toes bore the rudiments
